artworks.title: Cassandra
artworks.description: De Morgan's prophetess before the burning city — she tears at her flame-red hair as everything she foretold comes true and no one will listen.

artworks.title: Cassandra
artworks.description: Sandys' head of the seer — wide-eyed prophecy at the moment Troy falls, the curse Apollo set on her voice made visible.

artworks.title: Clytemnestra and Agamemnon
artworks.description: Guérin's Mycenaean night: the returning king asleep as Clytemnestra hesitates — the house-murder that will also claim Cassandra the captive.

artworks.title: Clytemnestra
artworks.description: Collier's queen just after the deed: bloodied axe on the palace threshold — Agamemnon and Cassandra already dead behind the curtain.

films.title: The Trojan Women
films.description: Bujold's Cassandra is Euripides' unbound prophetess — the captive voice that will next fall silent at Mycenae.
